title: Export provenance-rich trajectories without owning training recipes
narrative: Taloneth needs exportable execution packs that carry harness fingerprint, rollout refs, and outcomes so June can curate SFT or RL corpora without MechaHarness choosing the recipe. Accepts FineEnvs SFT-vs-RL reuse guidance[^fineenvs-export].
implementation: `LearningExportPack` and `build_learning_export` in `mechaharness.learning_export` bundle decision exports with fingerprint, rollout, and outcome refs.
validation: Kind `learning_export_pack`. Soft expects schema version and fingerprint. Unit tests in `tests/test_learning_export.py`.

footnotes.label: FineEnvs multi-harness RL — SFT vs RL
